outcome: A password-reset mail carries a link that points at this product and nowhere else.

acceptance_criteria.text: The reset mail contains the reset link.

expected_verification.assertion: the rendered body contains the link path

acceptance_criteria.text: A link pointing at a host this product does not own is refused rather than sent.

expected_verification.assertion: building a reset mail with an off-host link raises rather than returning a mail

data_impact: None. Mail bodies are composed in memory.
security_impact: A reset link is a credential-bearing URL; sending one that points elsewhere is a phishing vector carried by the product's own domain reputation.
